_about: Made-up answers from the snl-filings function's {action: "check"}, for the page tests. The wording matches supabase/functions/_shared/connection.ts.

steps.title: Signed in to S&P
steps.detail: S&P accepted the API username and password.

steps.title: Entitled to SNL Insurance Product Filings
steps.detail: S&P let the app read filings data (INSPRODFILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API).

steps.title: Loaded S&P's list of states
steps.detail: 3 states. Florida (FL) is in the list.

steps.title: Loaded the other three lists
steps.detail: Types of insurance 2, filing types 4, statuses 3.

ok.summary: The S&P connection works. The app signed in, can read SNL Insurance Product Filings and loaded all four lists. Florida is in the state list, so you can run your first search.

notConfigured.summary: S&P isn't set up yet, so there was nothing to check. When S&P sends the API username and password, set SPGMI_API_USERNAME and SPGMI_API_PASSWORD on Supabase (README, step 5), then click Check S&P connection again.

steps.title: Signed in to S&P
steps.detail: S&P accepted the API username and password.

steps.title: This S&P account can't use SNL Insurance Product Filings yet
steps.detail: S&P signed the app in but refused filings data (403, entitlement needed). Ask S&P to add the INSPRODFILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API entitlement (SNL Insurance Product Filings, Physical Documents API) to this API account.

entitlement.summary: The S&P connection isn't working yet. This S&P account can't use SNL Insurance Product Filings yet. Ask S&P for the entitlement named below.

steps.title: Couldn't sign in to S&P
steps.detail: S&P didn't accept the API sign-in (401). Check SPGMI_API_USERNAME and SPGMI_API_PASSWORD on Supabase. A Capital IQ Pro website login doesn't work here. S&P reference: req-signin-7.

signin.summary: The S&P connection isn't working yet. Couldn't sign in to S&P. The step below says what to do.
